title: Minimum time expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the minimum time as t = nh/(2c) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Speed in medium
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the relation v = c/n for the speed of light in the liquid.

title: Path for minimum time
description: Important Criteria: The reasoning must identify that the minimum time path is the straight vertical path from the source to the surface.

title: Critical angle identification
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly determine the critical angle using sin C = 1/n.

title: Surface area expression
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly state the area as S = 9πh²/(4(n²-1)) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Geometry for emission radius
description: Important Criteria: The working must correctly apply trigonometry to find the emission radius r = (3h/2) tan C.

title: Sign or domain error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the final area expression is given for n ≤ 1, where it is undefined or non-physical.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may demonstrate dimensional consistency for the time and area expressions.
